purpose: Build a versioned two-store source event primitive and controls,then audit fixed actual collection requests without treating destination cargo as proof it existed at source.
source_stores: Rural harvest enters a physical rural store before continuous meals/decay. Only actual rural overflow may enter the distinct export store at fixed fraction0.1;the rest stays explicitly uncollected. Export store has its own frozen parent capacity and5%loss. Pickups withdraw raw requested cargo only from export stock;partial and unfilled withdrawals explicit. Rural meals,export withdrawal sufficiency and conjunction separate;never filter rural failures.
clock: Inputs are explicit event times in[0,365). For equal times,aggregate harvest first,then rural overflow quota and export capacity clipping,then pickup requests in stable supplied-ID order. No transport retention is applied at source. In a later cohort adapter,pickup time=(origin bin start+(collection start+7*outward days+0.25handling)/7) modulo365;this handling location is a declared assumption,not observed timing. Destination one-bin lag remains separate.
periodic: Minimum repeating nonnegative rural stock solved independently of export;then construct actual quota pulses and solve minimum repeating export stock with discrete requests. Track every harvest,meal,stored loss,overflow/quota/uncollected,actual raw pickup and missing raw request. Full source mass identities per store and total;no finite stock loan.
controls: Before cohort outputs test empty/zero stores,one harvest with decay,local food before overflow,quota conservation,export capacity/uncollected,partial and impossible pickups,same-time deterministic priority,aggregation/reordering,periodic stocks/no free loan,invalid/nonfinite/cargo/clock rejection,retention absent and exact two-store mass closure. Independent scalar/source replay before real outcomes;all earlier modules unchanged.
later_cohort: After primitive controls,all8funded cases xbaseline/joint plus all8selected provider-year plans. Every local origin,including inactive/partial/rural-failed sources. Freeze all prior harvests,people,rural365day capacity,parent export capacity and actual packed job requests. Do not optimize capacity or dates to remove the exposed rural-meal deficit. Outside rural contexts remain in preceding audit with no invented provider. No automatic destination food replacement or new map qualification.
publication: Preserve every earlier map/default and all16rural audit rows. Full source/account/event/request fields,missing IDs,all comparison rows,independent review,fresh byte replay,normal methods/figures/downloads and whole-programme handoff. Any later propagated destination change needs its own explicit scope.
limits: Fixed inferred harvest-bin pulses and handling allocation,not historical harvest dates or actual institutions. Crew-carried food/location,complete diets/household/draft work,dated occupation/sizes/roles,prospective transfer,mobile/nonstate/unaffiliated integration and physics queue remain open. Push is a checkpoint;CONTINUE.
